title: GitHub accounts
subtitle: Accounts the agent on this computer uses to clone, commit and push. Tokens stay on it and are never shown.
place.globalOff: Shared access does not reach Global.
place.globalOk: Global serves folders outside a realm.
place.globalNote: Accounts for folders outside a realm.
noComputer: Pick a computer in the top bar to see its GitHub accounts.
allRealms.title: Pick a realm
allRealms.body: Each realm has its own GitHub accounts. Pick one realm from the realm menu at the top to see them, or choose Global above.
empty.title: No GitHub account yet
unknown.title: Accounts not read
unknown.body: The agent's answer did not list the accounts. Read them again in a moment.
unknown.addWaits: The accounts were not read yet. Read them again first.
health.help.ok: GitHub accepted this account just now.
health.help.invalid: GitHub no longer accepts this account's token. Add the account again, or switch to another one.
health.help.forbidden: GitHub refused this token, for example single sign-on not approved for an organisation, or access that was removed. Adding the same token again does not help.
health.help.unchecked: GitHub could not be reached to check this account. It may still work.
noPush: Can read, but cannot push: the token lacks repository access.
reason.busy: Another change to the accounts is waiting.
use.held: Switching to {{login}}: may have gone through.
use.heldElsewhere: Another page is switching accounts on this computer. Check it there.
logout.title: Log out {{login}}?
logout.body: The agent on this computer removes {{login}} in {{place}} and deletes the copies of its token from checkouts it can reach now. Copies in stopped computers, or in folders no open chat uses, stay. To remove it everywhere, revoke the token on GitHub.
logout.bodyActive: It is the account in use: another linked account, if there is one, is used instead.
logout.done: Logged out. Copies of the token in stopped computers, or in folders no open chat uses, may remain: revoke it on GitHub to remove it everywhere.
logout.held: Logging out {{login}}: may have gone through.
add.title: Add an account
add.body: Sign in at GitHub with a code. The account is added to {{place}} on this computer.
add.activateHelp: Off: the account is added and the one in use stays. The first account added is always used.
add.waits: A sign-in is already waiting. See it below.
add.steps.label: Sign in at GitHub
add.startHeld: Asking GitHub for a code: no answer. Nothing can be linked without the code; check again, then start over.
add.badStart: The agent's answer had no usable code. Nothing was linked. Try again.
add.codeHelp: Type it at GitHub when asked.
add.noLink: Go to github.com/login/device and type the code.
add.steps: Open GitHub, sign in if asked, then type the code and approve.
add.minutes: The code works for {{minutes}} minutes. The account shows here once GitHub confirms it.
add.earlier: A sign-in started here before is still waiting for GitHub. Its code was shown then; the account shows here once GitHub confirms it.
add.late: The sign-in started here before has ended.
add.held: GitHub may have linked the account. Check again reads the accounts; nothing is sent.
add.heldElsewhere: Another page is adding a GitHub account on this computer. Check it there.
add.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Nothing was linked. Start again.
add.denied: The sign-in was declined at GitHub. Nothing was linked.
add.rejected: GitHub gave a token that did not pass its check. Nothing was linked.
dismiss.title: Stop tracking?
dismiss.body: This page stops tracking it. The change may still have gone through: the account list shows it once it did.
